description: Angular component for a value stepper widget with SVG-based buttons, handling user interaction, dynamic resizing, and styling within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: ValueStepperWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a customizable value stepper with SVG buttons, dynamic styling, and resize handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component settings, styles, and data bindings.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Performs actions after view initialization, such as drawing SVG shapes if pending.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources like resize observers.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Additional initialization, including drawing SVG buttons and setting border radius.

methods.name: onValue
methods.description: Updates internal value state and disables buttons based on range limits.

methods.name: updateValueText
methods.description: Formats and updates the display text for the current value.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks to increment or decrement the value.

methods.name: drawSvg
methods.description: Creates SVG shapes for left and right buttons, sets up resize observers, and initializes button states.

methods.name: updateLeftDisabledState
methods.description: Updates disabled state for the left button.

methods.name: updateRightDisabledState
methods.description: Updates disabled state for the right button.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Adjusts sizes and scales of buttons and value box based on container dimensions.
